brand.name: DIGIY JOBS
brand.role: missions publiques, candidatures simples et accès recruteur encadré
brand.doctrine: Le candidat avance simplement. Le recruteur accède proprement.

active_missions.assistant_instruction: Do not claim that a mission is active unless the current public missions page displays it.

status_rules.mission: A mission must be currently returned by the public RPC and displayed on the public missions page.
status_rules.application: An application is a submission, not an interview, selection or employment promise.
status_rules.recruiter_access: Access to candidate profiles is controlled and limited to consented information.
status_rules.ndimbal: An NDIMBAL opportunity must be checked on its current public page before being described as available.

assistant_usage_notes: Use the current public missions page as the only source for time-sensitive active missions.
Do not create a static list of active missions from memory or old pages.
Do not expose or summarize private candidate profiles, phone numbers, CVs or personal data from protected areas.
Do not imply that an application guarantees an interview, selection, contract or payment.
For a public mission, state only the fields currently displayed publicly: title, sector, contract, city, country, pay, description and public application link.
For recruiter packs, explain that payment grants controlled access to a limited number of qualified and consented profiles, not ownership of candidate data.
